name: openbb_etf_search
description:
Search ETFs by name or keyword through the OpenBB Platform (obb.etf.search).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, intrinio; default fmp).
Fund facts: openbb_etf_info; keyless symbol search: yahoo_search_symbols. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"query": "dividend"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
